//: identity-consistency.test.ts asserts this plugin's version against cli/package.json — the shared version line. That file is not in this package and the CLI is not a dependency of it, so the default inputs do not hash it: a CLI-only version bump would leave this task's hash untouched and turbo would replay a cached pass, at exactly the moment the guard exists to fire. That suite parses this file and fails if an input it reads goes missing. Same reasoning as plugins/antigravity/turbo.json.
